children: Sweden AI contact center firm's Q2 net sales fell 71% yr/yr after US partner loss
Company posted negative adjusted EBITDA and gross margin declined to 70% from 88%
Teneo completed debt-to-equity swap, rights issue, and major cost reductions; now debt-free
Company says it will focus on growth by expanding Teneo 10's customer base
Teneo aims to maintain a materially lower cost base after restructuring and dismissals
Company expects debt-free balance sheet and new technology to support future operations
US PARTNER LOSS - Co attributed sharp revenue decline to loss of US distribution partner
COST REDUCTIONS - Co implemented major cost reductions including layoffs and vendor dismissals to lower operating expenses
PLATFORM REARCHITECTURE - Co launched Teneo 10, a rearchitected AI platform aimed at broadening customer base and reducing concentration risk
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Teneo AI AB is SEK0.60, about 841.9% above its August 28 closing price of SEK0.06
